hooks.command: CMD=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',d).get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null || true); case "$CMD" in *grep*|*rg\ *|*ripgrep*|*find\ *|*fd\ *|*ack\ *|*ag\ *)   [ -f graphify-out/graph.json ] &&   echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"MANDATORY: graphify-out/graph.json exists. You MUST run `graphify query \"<question>\"` before grepping raw files. Only grep after graphify has oriented you, or to modify/debug specific lines."}}'   || true ;; esac

HIT=$(python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);t=d.get('tool_input',d);exts=('.py','.js','.ts','.tsx','.jsx','.astro','.vue','.svelte','.go','.rs','.java','.rb','.c','.h','.cpp','.hpp','.cc','.cs','.kt','.swift','.php','.scala','.lua','.sh','.md','.rst','.txt','.mdx');vals=[str(t.get('file_path') or ''),str(t.get('pattern') or ''),str(t.get('path') or '')];j=' '.join(vals).lower().replace(chr(92),'/');tails=[('.'+x.rsplit('.',1)[-1]) for v in vals if v for x in [v.lower().replace(chr(92),'/').rsplit('/',1)[-1]] if '.' in x];sys.stdout.write('1' if 'graphify-out/' not in j and any(tl in exts for tl in tails) else '')" 2>/dev/null || true); if [ "$HIT" = 1 ] && [ -f graphify-out/graph.json ]; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"MANDATORY: graphify-out/graph.json exists. You MUST run graphify before reading source files. Use: `graphify query \"<question>\"` (scoped subgraph), `graphify explain \"<concept>\"`, or `graphify path \"<A>\" \"<B>\"`. Only read raw files after graphify has oriented you, or to modify/debug specific lines. This rule applies to subagents too — include it in every subagent prompt involving code exploration."}}'; fi || true

echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\": {\"hookEventName\": \"UserPromptSubmit\", \"additionalContext\": \"WERKZEUGREGEL (.claude/CLAUDE.md): Fuer jede Arbeit das dafuer vorgesehene Plugin/Skill benutzen, auch mehrere wenn noetig. Erst pruefen welches zustaendig ist, dann arbeiten. Code aendern = graphify orientieren -> arbeiten -> graphify update . -> code-review. Artefakt = artifact-design. App ansehen = run. Konfiguration = update-config. Passt keins: normal arbeiten und das in der Antwort sagen.\"}}"

HIT=$(python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);t=d.get('tool_input',d);p=str(t.get('file_path') or '').lower().replace(chr(92),'/');exts=('.ts','.tsx','.js','.jsx','.mjs','.cjs','.vue','.svelte','.astro','.py','.go','.rs');sys.stdout.write('1' if 'graphify-out/' not in p and p.endswith(exts) else '')" 2>/dev/null || true); if [ "$HIT" = 1 ] && [ -f graphify-out/graph.json ]; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PostToolUse", "additionalContext": "Quelldatei geaendert. Sobald die Aenderung steht und geprueft ist: graphify update . laufen lassen und den Graphen in einem eigenen Commit nachziehen."}}'; fi || true

if command -v graphify >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -f graphify-out/graph.json ] && [ -f graphify-out/manifest.json ] && [ -n "$(find src scripts -type f \( -name '*.ts' -o -name '*.tsx' -o -name '*.js' -o -name '*.mjs' \) -newer graphify-out/manifest.json -print -quit 2>/dev/null)" ]; then echo '{"decision": "block", "reason": "Der Wissensgraph ist aelter als der geaenderte Code. Jetzt graphify update . laufen lassen und graphify-out in einem eigenen Commit nachziehen. Schlaegt der Lauf fehl: dem Nutzer sagen, statt es zu umgehen."}'; fi || true
